summary: Clearwater County lookout: crow's nest about 1914, a 1930 pole tower, then a 1934 50-ft L-4 tower; removed (or destroyed) in 1962. No source describes the site now.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 50-ft pole tower (from 1934)
facts.status_note: Removed in the fall of 1962 per the Clearwater TPA report; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed

events.note: Crow's nest tree platform, the first lookout here
50-ft tower with L-4 cab replaced the 1930 tower
Maintenance work on the lookout structure
Clearwater TPA report: unused that season and removed in the fall; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed

evidence.supports: first lookout a crow's nest tree platform about 1914
evidence.quote: A crow's nest tree platform was the first lookout here about 1914

evidence.supports: 55-ft pole tower built 1930, replaced by a 50-ft pole L-4
evidence.quote: in 1923. A 55' pole tower with 5x5' cab was built in 1930, replaced by a 50' pole L-4

evidence.supports: agency is the Clearwater Timber Protective Association

evidence.quote: 1930: A 55-foot pole tower with 5 by 5 cab.
1934: A 50-foot round timber tower with an L-4 cab erected.
1954: Maintenance work was performed on the lookout structure.

evidence.supports: 1962 tower unused and removed in the fall, per Clearwater TPA annual report
evidence.quote: 1962: The tower determined to be in poor condition and unused this season because of improved detection methods was removed in the Fall.

evidence.supports: 1962 removal is from the combined 1961-62 Clearwater TPA annual report

corrections.why: 16.8 m is 55 ft, the height of the 1930 pole tower with a 5x5 cab. The L-4 tower that replaced it in 1934 was 50 ft, about 15.2 m.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Clearwater TPA annual report, quoted on Forest Lookouts, says the tower was removed in the fall of 1962. firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed. The record keeps 1962 and the story reports both accounts.
Forest Lookouts uses Clearwater Timber Protective Association; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts use Clearwater-Potlatch TPA. The record keeps the first name.

notes_for_editor: Build history (1914, 1930, 1934) is consistent across three sites. The 1962 end is disputed (removed vs destroyed). Height correction: the record's 16.8 m matches the 1930 55-ft pole tower, not the 1934 L-4 tower. Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site 'Drive-Up Destroyed'; the story does not use that label as an access statement. No staffing names were found. No source describes the site now, and access is not documented, so the access key is omitted.
